summary: This standards-track memo defines a DHCPv4 option, modelled on the DHCPv6 Rapid Commit option, that lets a client and server finish configuration in two messages instead of the usual four. This speeds up how quickly a client gets its address and settings.

eli5.summary: Getting a network address normally takes four back-and-forth steps. This option lets a computer and server skip ahead and finish in two, like ordering with a single exchange.
